queries: A player attempts a shot at the basket.
A basketball player shoots the ball toward the hoop.
queries_snapshot.definition: Start at the visible shooting motion; end at visible outcome or shot cut. Do not label dribbling or passing. Count a replay as a separate visible occurrence.

queries: A player wearing a dark jersey attempts a shot at the basket.
A dark-uniformed player shoots the basketball toward the hoop.
queries_snapshot.definition: Same shot boundary rule, but the shooter must visibly wear a dark jersey. No team identity inferred from filename.

queries: A player takes a free throw.
A player shoots a foul shot from the free-throw line.
queries_snapshot.definition: Visible free-throw shooting motion through outcome/cut. Presence and count require full review.

queries: Seated or standing substitutes cheer from the sidelines.
queries_snapshot.definition: Visible celebratory gesture by bench players, not any bench shot. Start/end with the gesture or shot cut.

queries: The camera shows a close-up of a player's face.
A basketball player's face is shown in close-up.
queries_snapshot.definition: A player head/shoulders is a prominent subject; not wide court footage. Split at cuts to unrelated scenes.

queries: A player dunks the basketball through the hoop.
A player scores by pushing the ball down through the rim.
queries_snapshot.definition: Require visible dunk evidence, not a layup or ordinary jump shot. Presence/count not assumed.

queries: A player kicks a soccer ball into a goal.
Someone scores a soccer goal by kicking the ball.
queries_snapshot.definition: Candidate absent event. Mark as negative only after reviewing the entire video.

queries: A person swims in a swimming pool.
Someone is swimming through the water in a pool.
queries_snapshot.definition: Candidate absent event. Mark as negative only after reviewing the entire video.

sampling_note: Requested fps/frame/token budgets; actual visual grid recorded per trial. total_tokens is a visual pixel budget, not a strict input-token cap.
timing_note: First query is cold; model download/load measured separately. No automatic OOM budget changes.
evaluation: unlabelled: no accuracy score; empty JSON and parse failure are distinct
